privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.localOnly: All notes are stored locally on your device only
privacy.noUpload: No data is uploaded to any server
privacy.fullControl: You have complete control over your content

welcome.intro2: - For those want complete content control!
welcome.todo1: - Check and respond to emails from clients and team members.
welcome.todo2: - Attend the daily stand-up meeting with the team to discuss progress and plans.
welcome.todo3: - Review and update the project requirements and user stories based on the feedback received.
welcome.todo4: - Start working on implementing new features or fixing existing bugs.
welcome.todo5: - Write and test code, and document it properly.
welcome.todo6: - Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to other team members.
welcome.todo7: - Attend meetings with clients to discuss project progress and gather feedback.
welcome.todo8: - Update project management tools and trackers with the latest information.
welcome.todo9: - Take breaks regularly to avoid burnout and ensure productivity.
welcome.todo10: - Learn new technologies or programming languages to enhance skills and knowledge.
